item.title: Color by Code CVC Words Level 3: Mystery Picture Reading Worksheets (Printable)
item.description: Printable color by code pages for beginning readers. Your child reads the decodable word in each square, colors it to match the key, and a mystery picture appears. Ten pictures that grow from two colors to six, using only the sounds s a t p i n m d g o c k. Answer key included.

item.title: Color by Code CVC Words Level 2: Mystery Picture Reading Worksheets (Printable)

item.title: Read and Match Worksheets Level 5: Decodable Words to Pictures (Printable)
item.description: Printable read and match worksheets for beginning readers. Six decodable words and six pictures on every page: your child sounds out each word, then draws a line to its picture. Every word uses only the sounds s a t p i n m d g o c k ck e u r h b f ff l ll ss. No prep needed, an answer key included, and pages ready in full color and in ink-saving black and white.

item.title: No Prep Beginning Sounds Practice: Letter Sounds Level 3 Worksheets
item.description: No prep phonics practice that pairs letter sounds with pictures to circle. Each printable page has one row for each sound, four pictures a row, and an answer key that names the pictures. Covers the sounds g, o, c, k, for kindergarten, homeschool literacy, morning work and reading centers.

item.title: No Prep Short O Word Family Practice: CVC Reading and Spelling Worksheets
item.description: No prep short o word practice for early readers. For kindergarten and 1st grade, homeschool phonics, morning work and reading centers.
